verdict.rationale: Kong's audit log reference states that AI Gateway logs capture request and response payloads, token usage, model details, latency, and cost metrics in a standardized format. Logs and metrics can be analyzed in Konnect or any OpenTelemetry tool, and cost is calculated per request to match provider billing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and explicit documentation of an interface for inspecting individual logged requests rather than only aggregated analytics or raw log files.
